name: Last Mile Enterprises Limited
summary: Last Mile Enterprises Limited engages in construction and engineering business activities in India. The company is also involved in the supply of mobile accessories, electronic products, and gadgets, such as smartwatches and speakers to headphones, and smart eyewear under the JUST CORSECA brand name, as well as OEM supplier to other brands. The company was formerly known as Trans Financial Resources Limited. Last Mile Enterprises Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
